text: year: - to provide ways and means: - to make complaint by its Customer against Sender of Unsolicited Commercial Communication in violation of the regulations provided that to register the complaint against- (i) RTMs or registered Senders, Customer should have registered his preferences; (ii) UTMs or unregistered Senders, there shall not be any pre-requisite of registration of Preferences by the Customer; to submit report(s), against sender(s) of commercial communication in violation of provisions of these regulation(s) by any customer; to provide following modes, as per choice of the customer and free of cost, to make complaint or to report violation of regulations: - sending SMS to short code 1909; or calling on 1909; or Interactive Voice Response System (IVRS); or Mobile app developed in this regard either by the Authority or by any other person or entity and approved by the Authority; or Web portal with authentication through One Time Password (OTP); or sending e-mail to a designated e-mail id of the Access Provider in the specified format. Any other means as may be notified by the Authority from time to time. Provided that every such complaint shall be made by a subscriber or recipient within seven days of receipt of the unsolicited commercial communication:; to duly acknowledge the receipt within fifteen minutes of the complaint or report made by the customer with unique reference number; to provide details to the subscriber about the mobile app provided for in sub-regulation (2)(d) to provide details of format and procedure to the
title: 05 commercial communications consolidated
